title: ACM HOPL — History of Programming Languages conference papers (HOPL I–IV)
description: Every paper of the four ACM SIGPLAN History of Programming Languages conferences (1978, 1993, 2007, 2020): designers' retrospectives (level 2 history) plus keynotes, the HOPL-I language summaries, the HOPL-II brief introductions and the HOPL-II Forum on the History of Computing. Q&A transcripts, biographies and session headers are omitted. Links go to an open copy where the authors or rights holders host one, otherwise to the ACM Digital Library (HOPL IV is open access there).
